'''Du Jiangfeng''' ({{lang-zh|c=杜江峰|p=Dù Jiāngfēng}}; born June 1969) is a Chinese physicist, university administrator and politician, an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]], currently serving as vice minister of [[Ministry of Education (China)|Education]] of China. He previously served as president of [[Zhejiang University]] from 2022 to 2025.

He is a member of the [[Chinese Communist Party]] (CCP). He is an alternate of the [[20th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party]].<ref>{{cite news |author1=Xu Kun ({{lang|zh|徐锟}}) |url=https://cn.chinadaily.com.cn/a/202210/22/WS63537f11a310817f312f2d1a.html |script-title=zh:中国共产党第二十届中央委员会候补委员名单（171名） |work=Chinadaily |date=22 October 2022 |access-date=28 October 2022 |language=zh}}</ref>

==Biography==
Du was born in [[Wuxi]], [[Jiangsu]], in June 1969.<ref name="du">{{cite news |author1=Wang Keyuan ({{lang|zh|王珂园}}) |url=https://paper.sciencenet.cn/htmlnews/2018/5/411659.shtm |script-title=zh:杨金龙、杜江峰任中国科学技术大学副校长 |work=sciencenet.cn |date=8 May 2018 |access-date=28 October 2022 |language=zh}}</ref> He attended {{ill|Tianyi High School of Jiangsu Province|zh|江苏省天一中学}} ({{lang-zh|s=江苏省天一中学|labels=no}}).<ref>{{cite news |author1=Wu Pingping ({{lang|zh|吴苹苹}}) |url=https://china.qianlong.com/2022/0606/7270608.shtml |script-title=zh:中国科学院院士杜江峰：保送中科大少年班却经历最苦时光 |work=qianlong.com |date=6 June 2022 |access-date=28 October 2022 |language=zh}}</ref> He earned a bachelor's degree in 1990, a master's degree in 1997, and a doctor's degree in 2000, all from the [[University of Science and Technology of China]].<ref name="du"/>

After graduating in 1990, he stayed and taught at his alma mater.<ref name="du"/> From 2005 to 2007, he was a researcher of [[Dortmund University]] in [[Germany]].<ref name="du"/> He was appointed as a "Changjiang Scholar" (or " Yangtze River Scholar") by the [[Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China]] in 2008.<ref name="du"/> He moved up the ranks to become deputy dean of its School of Physics in 2012 and vice president in April 2018.<ref name="du"/>

On 28 December 2022, the [[Organization Department of the Chinese Communist Party]] appointed Du as president of [[Zhejiang University]], a position at vice-ministerial level.<ref>{{cite news |url=https://mil.news.sina.com.cn/2022-12-28/doc-imxyfyze9386039.shtml |script-title=zh:浙大、武大迎来新校长 |work=sina |date=28 December 2022 |access-date=5 January 2023 |language=zh}}</ref>

On 25 February 2025, Du was appointed as vice minister of [[Ministry of Education (China)|Education]].<ref>{{cite news |url=https://english.news.cn/20250225/29aedeed56ff449985f47063dae1ddea/c.html |script-title=zh:浙大、武大迎来新校长 |work=Xinhua |date=25 February 2025 |access-date=26 February 2025 |language=zh}}</ref>

==Honours and awards==
* 2012 State Natural Science Award (Second Class) for the research on quantum computing based on nuclear spin
* October 2015 Member of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] (CAS)
* 2019 Science and Technology Progress Award of the [[Ho Leung Ho Lee Foundation]]
